title: 沪教牛津英语五年级下册（三年级起点）
sourceNote: 按用户提供的三年级起点五年级下册文本整理，页码沿用来稿，来稿未注明年份，未对照出版社原书逐页核验。保留单词音标、Listen and say、中文翻译、核心句型和Sounds；缺少正文的复习及附录仅保留目录。项目任务按来稿展示；原创基础题和补充口语表达另作标注，未提供原版示范音频。

units.title: Unit 1 Tidy up!

words.chinese: 你的；你们的（名词性物主代词）

sections.title: Tidy up!
sections.english:
Sally: Look at your bedroom. What a mess! Let’s tidy it up.
Peter: Sure, Sally.
Sally: Whose socks are those? Are they yours, Peter?
Peter: No, they aren’t. They’re Paul’s.
Sally: Can you put them on his bed?
Peter: Sure.
Sally: Whose cap is this?
Peter: It’s mine.
Sally: There’s a T-shirt. Is this yours too, Peter?
Peter: No. It’s Paul’s.
Sally: Can you put it on his bed?
Peter: Sure.
Peter: The room is now clean and tidy. Thank you for your help, Sally.
Sally: You’re welcome, Peter.
sections.chinese:
萨莉：看看你的卧室，一团糟！我们来整理一下吧。
彼得：好的，萨莉。
萨莉：那些是谁的袜子？是你的吗，彼得？
彼得：不是，是保罗的。
萨莉：你可以把袜子放到他床上吗？
彼得：好的。
萨莉：这是谁的帽子？
彼得：是我的。
萨莉：这里有一件T恤。这也是你的吗，彼得？
彼得：不是，是保罗的。
萨莉：你把它放到他床上好吗？
彼得：没问题。
彼得：房间现在干净整齐了。谢谢你帮忙，萨莉。
萨莉：不客气，彼得。

questions.explanation: 本单元中 tidy 表示“整理；整洁的”。

questions.explanation: 根据本单元主课文，答案是 Paul’s.

units.title: Unit 2 Our new home

sections.title: Our new home
sections.english:
Sally and her dad are at their new home.
Dad: Do you like our new home, Sally?
Sally: Yes. I like the living room.
Dad: Why do you like it?
Sally: Because it’s so big. What about you, Dad?
Dad: I like the study.
Sally: Why do you like it?
Dad: Because it’s quiet. I can read and write there.
Sally: Where are Peter and Paul?
Dad: They’re in the garden. They like our new home too. Do you know why?
Sally: Why?
Dad: Because they can play in the garden all day!
sections.chinese:
萨莉和爸爸在新家。
爸爸：萨莉，你喜欢我们的新家吗？
萨莉：喜欢。我喜欢客厅。
爸爸：你为什么喜欢客厅？
萨莉：因为它很大。你呢，爸爸？
爸爸：我喜欢书房。
萨莉：你为什么喜欢书房？
爸爸：因为很安静，我可以在那里读书写字。
萨莉：彼得和保罗在哪里？
爸爸：他们在花园。他们也喜欢新家。你知道为什么吗？
萨莉：为什么？
爸爸：因为他们可以一整天都在花园玩耍！

units.title: Unit 3 In the future

sections.title: In the future
sections.english:
Kitty wants to know about her future. She stands in front of a magic machine and takes a photo.
Kitty looks at her photo. There are some words on the back.
In fifteen years…
• You will not wear glasses.
• You will have big and beautiful eyes.
• You will live in Beijing.
• You will be a teacher.
• You will love your job.
Kitty: This is me in the future! I won’t wear glasses. I’ll have big and beautiful eyes. I’ll live in Beijing and I’ll be a teacher.
sections.chinese:
基蒂想知道自己的未来。她站在一台神奇机器前拍了一张照片。
基蒂看着照片，背面写着一些文字。
十五年后……
你不会戴眼镜。
你会拥有一双漂亮的大眼睛。
你会住在北京。
你会成为一名老师。
你会热爱你的工作。
基蒂：这就是未来的我！我不用戴眼镜，会有一双漂亮的大眼睛。我会住在北京，成为一名老师。

Ms Guo: The Spring Festival is an important Chinese festival. It’s also called Chinese New Year. It comes in January or February.
Kitty: What do people do at this festival?

Alice: What other important festivals do we have?

Kitty: We also have the Mid-Autumn Festival. It comes in September or October. People look at the moon and eat mooncakes.

units.title: Unit 12 The giant’s garden

sections.title: The giant’s garden
sections.english:
A giant lives in a big house with a beautiful garden. Children like to play in the garden. They have a lot of fun there.
The giant goes away. When he comes back, he sees the children in his garden. He is very angry.
Giant: This is my garden! You can’t play here.
He builds a high wall around the garden. Spring does not come to the giant’s garden. It is always winter there.
One morning, the giant hears some lovely sounds. He sees some beautiful flowers too. The giant is very happy.
Giant: Hooray! Spring is here!
The giant finds some children in his garden. They are coming through a hole. They bring Spring to his garden!
The giant knocks down the wall around his garden.
Giant: Children, you can play in my garden any time.
sections.chinese:
巨人住在一栋大房子里，房子配有美丽花园。孩子们喜欢在花园玩耍，玩得很开心。
巨人外出，回来的时候看见孩子们在花园里，他非常生气。
巨人：这是我的花园！你们不能在这里玩。
他在花园四周筑起高墙。春天再也不来巨人的花园，那里永远是冬天。
一天早上，巨人听见悦耳的声音，还看见了美丽的花朵。巨人十分开心。
巨人：太好了！春天来了！
巨人看见花园里有几个孩子，他们从墙洞里钻进来，是他们把春天带进花园！
巨人推倒了围墙。
巨人：孩子们，你们随时都可以来我的花园玩耍。

units.sentencePrompt: 用本单元词句和同伴交流。
units.sentenceAnswer: Children can play in my garden.
